title: Chat question summary
description: An answered question in a chat transcript (`.chat-question-carousel-container.chat-question-carousel-used`): "Question: …" with the chosen answer below on a connector ("Answered: …"). It replaces the question carousel once the user answers.

examples.title: Answered
examples.html: <vsc-chat-response><vsc-chat-question-summary question="Continue with the rendering changes?" answer="Confirm (Recommended)"></vsc-chat-question-summary></vsc-chat-response>
